article.title: Chair skills, quick brain - how O'Neill adapted to wheelchair rugby league
article.summary: Finlay O'Neill thought his sporting days were over when his dislocated a knee at the age of 16. Now he is preparing to play a part in England's bid to retain the Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup.
